variables.name: periodUid
variables.comment: The unique id of the timeline period.

variables.name: adGroupIndex
variables.comment:
* If the media period is in an ad group, the index of the ad group in the period. {@link
   * C#INDEX_UNSET} otherwise.

variables.name: adIndexInAdGroup
variables.comment:
* If the media period is in an ad group, the index of the ad in its ad group in the period.
   * {@link C#INDEX_UNSET} otherwise.

variables.name: windowSequenceNumber
variables.comment:
* The sequence number of the window in the buffered sequence of windows this media period is part
   * of. {@link C#INDEX_UNSET} if the media period id is not part of a buffered sequence of windows.

variables.name: nextAdGroupIndex
variables.comment:
* The index of the next ad group to which the media period's content is clipped, or {@link
   * C#INDEX_UNSET} if there is no following ad group or if this media period is an ad.

methods.name: public MediaPeriodId copyWithPeriodUid(Object newPeriodUid)
methods.comment: Returns a copy of this period identifier but with {@code newPeriodUid} as its period uid.

methods.name: public MediaPeriodId copyWithWindowSequenceNumber(long windowSequenceNumber)
methods.comment: Returns a copy of this period identifier with a new {@code windowSequenceNumber}.

methods.name: public boolean isAd()
methods.comment: Returns whether this period identifier identifies an ad in an ad group in a period.
